{{Top|leg}}
'''Onderonian''' was a dialect of the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] that was spoken by the Human inhabitants of the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. It was considered important enough, although offworlders from the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Teta system]] needed no extra training to understand and speak Onderonian.
